'''Dix Tarfait''' was a [[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], making a living as a small-time liquor distributor. After undertaking a luxury cruise aboard the [[Luxury liner/Legends|liner]] ''[[Salin Mariner]]'', Tarfait and several other passengers were kidnapped and held to ransom by the [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]]. However, Tarfait was not as wealthy as Ohnaka had believed him to be and the pirate was only able to extract enough [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] for eight cases of [[Grog/Legends|grog]] in return for Tarfait's freedom. Ohnaka and his [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|gang]] subsequently off-loaded Tarfait and their other hostages onto a passing delivery [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]].
